notes: Written 2026-11-03 from the build's own definitions only: runs/full/zflx/r2/exec/workflow_*.md (the SCRIPT of each batch workflow: the input keys it reads through inp([...]) and the keys of output.result), the END payloads from the transcript's configure_end_node inputs (every batch workflow: payload ${result}), builder/assumptions.md #1 (input files as top-level keys named by file name, value = text or list of lines; outputs under their contract names; a missing input is an absent key) and builder/notes/build-ids.md. No workflow was run.
Context: workspaceId <uuid>, appId and appVersionId from runs/full/zflx/r2/log.txt line 'project:' (version bb63b5da-..., also in exec/version.txt).

Added steps: each input file goes under its own file name (the scripts read inp(['<name>.dat', '<name>']) and take the first). missing = omit (assumptions.md #1). Outputs and the return code are read under the contract names the scripts write ('<step>_rc.txt' is written only on the abend path, value '999'; a normal end omits it, read as 0). wrap and root null: the END payload is ${result}, and the executor reads out['result'] if present, else the payload itself.

dailycheck: the cases also give custdata.dat, carddata.dat and transact.dat; the script reads only dailytran, cardxref and acctdata (assumptions.md #44). They are sent under their file names and are not read by the build.

Core steps: map = the adapters' canonical names -> the START keys the scripts read. posttran: dailytran, acctdata, cardxref, tcatbal (business_date not sent: the script takes the date from RUN_TIMESTAMP, assumptions.md #2). intcalc: tcatbal, acctdata, cardxref, discgrp, and intcalc_parm -> 'parm' (the script reads inp(['parm','PARM','interestRunDate']), assumptions.md #31). creastmt: transact, acctdata, cardxref, custdata. tranrept: transact, cardxref, trantype, trancatg, start_date -> startDate, end_date -> endDate (the script reads inp(['startDate','start_date','reportStartDate']) and the same for the end; assumptions.md #35). decode = contract output name -> the END key the script writes ('posttran_transact.json', ..., 'tranrept_report.txt').
No COMBTRAN step in the build (assumptions.md #5); none is needed by the executor (step isolation).
